observation_summary: The SmartNullPointerException message failed to include the parameters of the method call that caused the exception, leading to an assertion failure in the test.
hypothesis: The Reporter.smartNullPointerException method lacked the necessary parameter (the object/invocation details) to include the method arguments in the exception message. The fix involves updating the method signature to accept the object and including it in the exception message construction.
prediction: The code will show an updated method signature for smartNullPointerException in the Reporter class and a corresponding update in the call site within ReturnsSmartNulls to pass the missing object.
experiment_rationale: The diff confirms that the method signature of smartNullPointerException was changed to accept an additional 'Object obj' parameter, which is then used in the exception message. This is a classic interface contract mismatch where the reporter needed more information than it was receiving.
reasoning_summary: The bug is classified as Interface/O-O Messages because the fix required changing the method signature of 'smartNullPointerException' to accept an additional parameter ('obj') that was previously missing, and updating the caller to provide this information. This is a communication/contract issue between the 'ReturnsSmartNulls' component and the 'Reporter' component.
evidence_used: The diff shows the method signature of 'smartNullPointerException' in 'org.mockito.exceptions.Reporter' changed from 'smartNullPointerException(Location location)' to 'smartNullPointerException(Object obj, Location location)'.
The diff shows the call site in 'org.mockito.internal.stubbing.defaultanswers.ReturnsSmartNulls' updated to pass the 'obj' parameter.
The test failure indicates the exception message was missing information (the parameters 'oompa' and 'lumpa').

alternative_types.why_not_primary: While the logic inside the method was updated, the root cause is the mismatch in the interface contract (the method signature) between the caller and the reporter.
